nameEn: Retail sale of audio and video equipment in specialised stores
description: This class includes the retail sale of audio and video equipment in specialised stores.
includes: retail sale of radio and television equipment
retail sale of DVD players, Blu-ray players
retail sale of stereo equipment: amplifiers, speakers
retail sale of CD, DVD, Blu-ray discs and audio cassettes
excludes: retail sale of computers and peripherals, see 4741
